meta.description: Character LoRA on IllustriousXL (SDXL arch). Point model.name_or_path at your local Illustrious checkpoint if you have one. Use booru-style tag captions with a unique trigger tag first. Speed (2026-08-29): latents are served from RAM after the first pass (cache_latents + cache_latents_to_disk — disk-only caching re-read every latent every step), loss_sync_every 4, ui_db_poll_seconds 2. Training math unchanged. STEP TABLE (meta.step_table, revised 2026-10-12): 20 images ~2000, 30 images ~3000, 40 images ~4000; above 40 images it follows 0.75x the arch exposure target for your exact count (never below the 40-image value, no hard cap - e.g. Anima ~4850 at 100 / ~7750 at 200, illxl ~6500 at 100 / ~10300 at 200), which keeps the exposure gauge in its healthy band - the exposure gauge judges sizes past the table against the arch exposure target and shows warm/hot if the run is getting long. Source: the SDXL-arch 100 steps/image exposure target at 20/30 images and the old SDXL ceiling (4000) as the last anchor at 40. Values are steps at effective batch 1 - the Step Suggestion panel and exposure gauge use this table while the preset is loaded and divide by your effective batch (batch_size x gradient_accumulation); below the first row the first row's steps apply.
